hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Profile
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration and wide, straight lanes encourage higher vehicle speeds, increasing risk for pedestrians and cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from large vehicle
hazards.description: A large SUV in the immediate foreground blocks the sightlines between pedestrians entering the crosswalk and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crosswalk to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and tighten the turning radius for vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points and install curb extensions to improve sightlines and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Given the high pedestrian activity and wide plaza, a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility markings would provide a safe, designated point for pedestrians to cross the roadway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes warrant, install a high-visibility mid-block crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe, designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the long crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Speed Management
interventions.description: Utilize traffic calming measures or lower speed limits to mitigate the risks associated with the wide roadway design.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB)
interventions.description: Given the width and likely traffic volume, a signalized mid-block crossing would significantly improve safety.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Install physical barriers such as bollards or a raised curb to separate the bike lane from motor vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk with Daylighting
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand is high, install a marked mid-block crossing and remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to it (daylighting) to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and reallocate space for protected bike lanes or wider pedestrian buffers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade parallel line markings to continental or zebra patterns to increase the visibility of the crossing to approaching motorists.
